findings.evidence: Kummer.lean:102 `let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P)) := ⟨fun a ha ↦ ... Ideal.mem_of_liesOver P (maximalIdeal A) a ...⟩`. The only Mathlib instance close to this is `Mathlib/RingTheory/LocalRing/ResidueField/Ideal.lean:175` (from `AtPrime I` to `AtPrime J`), which does not cover the map from `R`.
findings.fix: Add a lemma such as `Localization.AtPrime.isLocalHom_algebraMap_of_liesOver [IsLocalRing R] (q) [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver (maximalIdeal R)] : IsLocalHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q))`. Drop the hypothesis from `isSeparable_quotient_iff_residueField` and replace the inline proof at Kummer.lean:102 with this lemma.
findings.issue: `isSeparable_quotient_iff_residueField` assumes `[IsLocalHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q))]`, which follows from `[IsLocalRing R]` and `[q.LiesOver (maximalIdeal R)]`: a nonunit `r ∈ maximalIdeal R` maps into `q`, so its image is a nonunit of `R_q`. The same argument is proved by hand at Kummer.lean:102 in `exists_uniformizer_localizationAtPrime_of_tame`.

findings.evidence: Grep for `AdjoinSimple.gen .* \^ .* = algebraMap` returns BaseChange/TamelyRamified.lean:90,254,298, BaseChange/Kummer.lean:376,481 and DiscreteValuationRing/Kummer.lean:469, all proved with the same `rw [map_pow, AdjoinSimple.algebraMap_gen, ..., ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply ...]` chain.
findings.fix: State it once in `TauCeti/FieldTheory/IntermediateField/Adjoin/Defs.lean`, e.g. `AdjoinSimple.gen_pow_eq_algebraMap [IsScalarTower A K Ω] (h : α ^ n = algebraMap A Ω a) : AdjoinSimple.gen K α ^ n = algebraMap A K⟮α⟯ a`, plus the analogous statement for `IntermediateField` elements. Use it at every call site.
findings.issue: The same step, deriving `AdjoinSimple.gen K α ^ n = algebraMap A K⟮α⟯ π` from `α ^ n = algebraMap A Ω π` with an `injective` and `rw` chain, is re-proved at TamelyRamified.lean:90, 254 and 298, at BaseChange/Kummer.lean:376 and 481, and for `hβ₁`/`hγ₁` in `IsTamelyRamifiedWRT.baseChange`. A copy already exists at DiscreteValuationRing/Kummer.lean:469.

summary: Main statements sit at the natural level and the dropped hypotheses are justified; one public lemma carries a derivable `IsLocalHom` hypothesis whose proof is duplicated inline, and a root-transfer step is re-proved six times instead of being stated once.
